title: Large Business & International (LB&I)

requirements.text: One year of experience refers to full-time work; part-timework is considered on a prorated basis.
requirements.evidence: You must meet the following requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

requirements.text: A college or university degree generally must be from an accredited (or pre-accredited) college or university recognized by the U.S. Department of Education.
requirements.evidence: For a list of schools which meet these criteria, please refer to Department of Education Accreditation page .

requirements.text: Education completed in foreign colleges or universities may be used to meet the requirements.
requirements.evidence: You must show proof the education credentials have been deemed to be at least equivalent to that gained in conventional U.S. education program.
